title: Pharmacological investigation of natural compounds for therapeutic potential in neuropathic pain.
authors: Faheem, Muhammad; Khan, Arif-Ullah; Shah, Fawad Ali
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然化合物对神经病理性疼痛的药理作用，涉及蛋白-小分子对接与MD模拟，但对象为COX-2/TNF/NF-κB等炎症蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: The present research is based on the investigation of post treatment naturally occurring compounds berbamine (BBM), bergapten (BRG) and carveol (CAR) in relation to its therapeutic effect in neuroinflammation and chronic constriction injury induced neuropathic pain (CCI-NP). The drug-likeness of the compounds was explored by SwissADME (http://www.swissadme.ch/). Docking was performed by Auto dock, PyRx and Discovery Studio Visualiser 2016 against cyclooxygenase-2 (COX-2) (PDB ID: ICX2), tumour necrosis factor-alpha TNF-alpha (PDB ID: 10T7) and nuclear factor-kappa B (NF-kappab) (PDB ID: INFK). Molecular dynamic simulation was performed through Desmond software. In in-vivo protocols, sciatic nerve was ligated and treatment was initiated and maintained until the 14th day. Behavioural assays (paw deformation, thermal hyperalgesia, mechanical allodynia and cold allodynia) were performed and tissues were extracted for molecular investigation. Hydrogen bonds and binding affinities of ligand target complex were determined. Berbamine showed binding against NF-kappaB (7.9 kcal/mol). Treatment reversed paw deformation, reduced thermal hyperalgesia, mechanical allodynia and cold allodynia. Treatment also improves the level of protective GSH and GST levels in the sciatic nerve and spinal cord and lowering the detrimental oxidative stress markers iNOS and LPO. Based on the results the aforementioned compounds correct behavioural deficit, inhibit COX-2, TNF-, and NF-kappaB over expression, as evidenced by Enzyme-linked immunosorbant assay (ELISA) provide neuroprotection in chronic constriction damage. Hence berbamine can be considered as neuroprotective compound.
abstract_zh: 本研究基于对天然化合物小檗胺（berbamine, BBM）、佛手柑内酯（bergapten, BRG）和香芹醇（carveol, CAR）在神经炎症及慢性压迫性损伤诱导的神经病理性疼痛（CCI-NP）中治疗效果的后期处理调查。通过SwissADME（http://www.swissadme.ch/）探索了化合物的药物相似性。利用Auto dock、PyRx和Discovery Studio Visualiser 2016对环氧合酶-2（COX-2）（PDB ID: ICX2）、肿瘤坏死因子-α（TNF-alpha）（PDB ID: 10T7）和核因子-κB（NF-kappaB）（PDB ID: INFK）进行了对接。通过Desmond软件进行了分子动力学模拟。在体内实验中，结扎坐骨神经并开始治疗，持续至第14天。进行了行为学测试（爪变形、热痛觉过敏、机械性异常性疼痛和冷异常性疼痛），并提取组织进行分子研究。确定了配体-靶标复合物的氢键和结合亲和力。小檗胺对NF-kappaB显示出结合力（7.9 kcal/mol）。治疗逆转了爪变形，减少了热痛觉过敏、机械性异常性疼痛和冷异常性疼痛。治疗还提高了坐骨神经和脊髓中保护性GSH和GST水平，并降低了有害的氧化应激标志物iNOS和LPO。基于上述结果，所述化合物纠正了行为缺陷，抑制了COX-2、TNF-α和NF-kappaB的过度表达，如酶联免疫吸附试验（ELISA）所证实，在慢性压迫性损伤中提供神经保护。因此，小檗胺可被视为神经保护化合物。
